system.description: Inspires panic in [[/r 2d4]] + 1 per level humanoids of 2 HD or fewer (Save vs. Spells negates). Affected targets can take no other actions and roll [[/r 1d6]]: 1: Screams and flees randomly; 2: Sobs uncontrollably; 3: Attacks nearest humanoid; 4: Vomits loudly; 5: Curls into fetal position; 6: Referee's choice.
